name: Yanbu National Petrochemical Company
summary: Yanbu National Petrochemical Company manufactures and sells petrochemical products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company's products portfolio includes ethylene, propylene, mono ethylene glycol, di ethylene glycol, tri ethylene glycol, polypropylene, low linear density polyethylene, high density polyethylene, butene 1, butene 2, methyl tert-butyl ether, benzene, and toluene-xylene-benzene blend.
